examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
examples.trans: Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!

examples.text: 今天下午的气温是二十度。
examples.trans: The temperature this afternoon is twenty degrees.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn zhù shī. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位建筑师 ('an architect').

examples.text: 你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
examples.trans: Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.

examples.text: 声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
examples.trans: An acoustic architect! Do you design concert halls?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hěn. Links a subject to a simple predicate adjective without needing 是 (今天很冷 'It is cold today').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me. Before a verb, asks 'how to do X?' (怎么走) or 'how come…?' (怎么还没来).

examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huāng. Describes feeling rattled or panicked (别慌 'don't panic').

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suó yǐ. Introduces a result or conclusion, often after 因为.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
examples.trans: Decibels? So nine points was not a score for my front-desk service?

meanings.en: hit; make (a call); give (a score); fetch
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ. Light verb forming dozens of everyday expressions (打电话 'make a phone call').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎng. Used for blocking wind, rain, or a doorway (挡住).

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
examples.trans: Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.

examples.text: 大树挡住了下午的阳光。
examples.trans: The big tree shaded the afternoon sun.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng. Combines with a measure word to mean 'the entire' (整条街 'the whole street', 整栋楼 'the whole building').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

meanings.note: Pinyin: rì zi. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 一段好日子 ('happy days').

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。

examples.trans: Days spent drinking tea and reading in the courtyard are lovely.

examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

examples.text: 老朋友见面，聊起许多二十年前的旧事。
examples.trans: Old friends met up and chatted about many memories from twenty years ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 每个星期五 ('every Friday').

examples.text: 我念念：对不起拿错了，请帮我保管到星期五。
examples.trans: Let me read it: Sorry for taking the wrong one; please keep mine until Friday.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng jí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 五星级 ('a five-star rating').

examples.text: 仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！

examples.text: 小客栈虽小，干净程度不输星级酒店。
examples.trans: Though small, the inn is every bit as spotless as a star-rated hotel.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuó wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 昨天晚上 ('last night').

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

examples.text: 昨晚您的本子在柜台翻开了，我们看到九分……
examples.trans: Last night your notebook fell open on the counter, and we saw nine points...

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fú wù. Measure word (量词): 项, e.g. 一项服务 ('a service').

examples.text: 我们客栈都是五星级服务……哎呀！
examples.trans: At our inn, everything is five-star service... whoops!

examples.text: 分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
examples.trans: Decibels? So nine points was not a score for my front-desk service?

条.gloss: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses

meanings.en: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses
meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo. Counts long, narrow, or winding things: streets, rivers, scarves, towels, trousers, and legal clauses (一条街).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù yè. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片树叶 ('a leaf').

examples.trans: Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.

examples.text: 风一吹，绿树叶沙沙地响。
examples.trans: When the breeze blows, the green leaves rustle softly.

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。

examples.text: 难怪昨晚您在阁楼听街上有没有汽车声！
examples.trans: No wonder you listened in the attic last night for car sounds from the street!

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí qiáng. Measure word (量词): 堵 (dǔ), e.g. 一堵石墙 ('a stone wall').

examples.text: 主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。

examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shè jì. Works as both verb ('design') and noun ('a design').

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。

meanings.note: Pinyin: gé lóu. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间阁楼 ('an attic room').

examples.text: 这是三楼阁楼门的小银钥匙。

meanings.note: Pinyin: fù jìn. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 附近一带 ('the nearby area').

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！

meanings.note: Pinyin: gé. Describes being separated by a wall, door, or interval of time (隔着).

examples.text: 小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。

examples.text: 难怪昨晚您在阁楼听街上有没有汽车声！
